name: Astro Console
status: selected V1 mark; package-level brand release

wordmarkReference.clearSpace: one symbol radius around the complete lockup
wordmarkReference.limitation: This reference composition retains system font text. It is not a deployable canonical wordmark until the lettering is outlined from licensed, approved type source. The symbol is the authoritative V1 production mark.

usage: Use ink on field paper or equivalent light grounds; light on deep night; mono only where one-color reproduction is required. Do not redraw, animate, separate the companion, or remove the field-of-view crop.
licensing: Project-owned artwork. Do not redistribute outside Astro Console without owner approval.
governance: Any geometry, color, or wordmark-outline change requires a new versioned package and recorded owner approval.
